author: nemi
text: My teacher knew what time my bedroom light went off. I hadn't told him. I hadn't told anyone.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: Okay. Let me go back, because that sounds like the end of a horror movie. I was fifteen. This was an ordinary school, with broken fans and a bell that sounded personally offended.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: He taught English. Everyone liked him. He remembered birthdays, lent people books, stayed after class. You know, the teacher your parents called dedicated.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: At first, he just asked about my drawings. He'd stop beside my desk and say, you're quiet today. And I thought, oh. Somebody actually noticed.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: Then he started keeping my notebook after class. Just a minute, he'd say. The minute always lasted until the corridor was empty.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: Nothing dramatic happened. That was the confusing part. He'd ask who I walked home with. Whether my mum worked late. Questions that didn't belong anywhere near my English homework.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: I answered because he was a teacher. Saying, why do you need to know that, felt ruder than giving him my entire afternoon.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: One day he asked why I'd stopped taking the main road home. I laughed. Like, awkward little laugh. Then I realized I hadn't mentioned changing my route.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: He said he'd seen me from his car. Perfectly normal explanation. Except the shortcut was behind the shops. You couldn't see it from the main road.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: I told my friend. We did that thing where you make something a joke so you don't have to decide how scared you are. Oh, great. Personal attendance service.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: She walked home with me the next day. We stopped at a stationery shop. Across the street, beside a parked car, was my teacher.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: He didn't wave. Didn't come over. Just looked at us. My friend stopped laughing before I did.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: After that, I started noticing the same car. Near the school gate. Outside the bakery. Once, at the end of my lane. I kept inventing reasons for it to be there.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: Then a message came from a number I didn't recognize. Did you get home safely? It was him. He said he'd got my number from the school contact list.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: I typed, yes sir, thank you. I hate remembering that. I was scared, and I still added thank you.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: The messages got stranger. You're up late. Who was that with you? Then, don't mention these chats at school. People misunderstand kindness.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: I didn't reply to that one. The next morning he put my notebook on my desk, leaned down, and said, ignoring people isn't very nice.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: He said it softly. Everyone else was getting their books out. I remember staring at the date on the board because looking at him felt impossible.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: That evening, I left my lamp on while I went downstairs. When I came back, there was another message. Long night studying?
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: My bedroom faced the lane. From the road, you couldn't see me. Just the light behind the curtain. And suddenly all those questions sounded different.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: I took the phone to my mum. I tried to start with the first message, but I couldn't get the words out. So I just handed it over.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: She read it twice. Then she shut the curtain. That tiny thing, the sound of those rings sliding across the rail, is what I remember most.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: The next morning she came to school with me. We took screenshots. My friend told them about the shop. For once, I didn't have to make it sound harmless.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: He called it concern. Said I'd taken it the wrong way. Mum asked why concern needed to be a secret. He didn't answer that.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: I was moved to another class while the school dealt with it. Mum collected me for a while. The messages stopped. I wasn't told everything that happened after that.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: For weeks, even with my phone switched off, I'd look at it when a car slowed outside. I used to check the curtain before I checked my homework.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: And that first line? The one about my bedroom light? He said it when Mum was standing right there. I was only checking you were getting enough sleep.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi
text: He sounded so reasonable. That's the part that still bothers me. He said it like we'd misunderstood him. Like watching my window was the most normal thing in the world.
speaker: sohee
identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.
